descriptionChirho: A raised structure or place for presenting sacrifices and offerings to God; in the NT used of the Jerusalem temple altar, the altar of incense, and the heavenly altar in Revelation. Multilingual evidence uniformly maps singular and plural to the same concept: Spanish 'altar/altares', Hindi 'vedi', Arabic 'al-madhbahi/madhabhiha', Korean 'jedan/jedandeureul', Swahili 'madhabahu'. The singular forms (N-ANS, N-GNS, N-DNS, N-NNS) with 22 occurrences and the single plural form (N-ANP) represent grammatical number inflection of one unified lexical sense.
